title: Sparse Text Diffusion under Dual Budgets: Context Connectivity and Expert Activation
abstract: arXiv:2610.41487v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-context diffusion repeatedly pays for both token interaction and feed-forward computation. We formulate these costs as two separate budgets: the edges available to an attention graph and the experts activated for each token. This view connects local, dilated, and global attention with conditional expert computation without assuming that sparsity alone preserves document-level information. We specify normalized masked attention, distinguish denoising depth from sampling iterations, and derive graph and compute bounds. A reported sparse-expert configuration, denoted DualBudget, is analyzed across scientific summarization, multi-hop question answering, dialogue, and sentence-pair prediction. All supplied table measurements are retained. The length study shows gains over the listed baselines through 16K, together with measurable degradation as length increases. translated_title: 双预算下的稀疏文本扩散：上下文连接性与专家激活
translated_abstract: 长上下文扩散模型在词元交互和前馈计算上都需要反复付出代价。我们将这些成本形式化为两个相互独立的预算：注意力图可用的边数，以及每个词元所激活的专家数量。这一视角将局部、扩张和全局注意力与条件化专家计算统一起来，而不假设稀疏性本身就能保留文档级信息。我们规范了归一化掩码注意力，区分了去噪深度与采样迭代次数，并推导了图结构和计算量的上下界。文中对一种报告的稀疏-专家配置（记为 DualBudget）进行了分析，涵盖科学摘要、多跳问答、对话和句子对预测等任务，并保留了所有已提供的表格测量结果。长度研究显示，在 16K 范围内该方法的性能优于所列基线，但随着长度增加出现了可测量的性能下降。消融实验表明三项报告指标的改进情况不一，而原文在此处截断。
tldr: 该论文提出以“注意力边数”和“专家激活数”两个独立预算来刻画长上下文扩散模型的计算成本，并据此分析稀疏-专家配置 DualBudget，在最高 16K 的长度范围内的摘要、多跳问答、对话等任务上优于基线。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes long-context diffusion costs under two separate budgets—attention-graph edges and per-token expert activations—and analyzes a sparse-expert configuration, DualBudget, which outperforms listed baselines on summarization, multi-hop QA, dialogue, and sentence-pair tasks up to 16K length.
